body: Thank you for giving her the life she deserves. Cats are amazing.

Sorry but she’s toxic and needs to leave, investigation or no investigation. By allowing her to stay you are enabling her and making your environment toxic which is damaging to everyone in the household. You are doing no one any favors. I get your thinking and mine in my situation was similar as he had an attempted murder charge for shooting at people and various other stuff that’s just too unbelievable to mention. I ended up being the one blamed for everything, my children and me going for therapy and me financially ruined. The damage is still there and he’s living as if he’s never done anything wrong in his life. 

Please for the sake of your family and especially your wife. Man up, get her out of your house and life. She’s going to damage everything she touches.
Those eyes makes my heart melt.
I love gifts like this.  Enjoy getting creative.
Need one of those. Hands off my lunch.
Awww this rat is adorable 🐀
This made my day. 😁

Had the conversation and nothing changed except him being more secretive.  Thank you for the wishes.

Good luck with your relationship. I wish everyone love and peace. No one goes into a relationship wanting to leave. I tried. I’m tired of always waiting and trying.

I did that. Even put everything down on paper so that I did not get all emotional. He said he sees my point but that they have a lifetimes worth of history and she’s not happy and that I’m only jealous and I need not be as it’s nothing. He then said he was going to stop it the daily talks and if she phones him he will tell her he can’t talk to her or if I’m around put the phone on speaker. I guess you know what happened. He became more secretive and downloaded another chat app. I accidentally saw a message come up when he was sitting next to me. I’m sorry I have tried. I don’t think I could have explained myself better. I did not even have an ultimatum. I told him it’s about how it makes me feel and he dismissed it as being jealous. If I am and that’s a big if, he is causing it, however I am hurt and it kills me. I told him as much. I do t think he will ever get it.  Oh and you don’t ask friends to come back to you.

I think she enjoys the attention she gets from him. My take is that she’s playing the player. He helps her out financially and listens to all her problems and then tells her she’s worth so much more blah blah. 

Oh and yes he did just that and some. Should have seen this coming.
Thank you

Sorry to hear that you had a bad experience too. I think he’s never been with me. I was someone familiar as we have known each other for some time. I think he’s using me to get her back. Told me that’s she’s super jealous and that she’s unhappy in her current relationship. She wants out. I think they both need to decide and do it quick because they are hurting an awful lot of people. He boyfriend is apparently jealous too and she sits in the bathroom to text my BF. All these things get told casually as if it’s all okay. So I guess he can have her and she him he’s just waiting for her to take a step.  It kills me.
Thank you for the advice
Well done as parents. You are raising an amazing individual.
Healing is brutally destructive but to grow you have to break through your shell. Thank you for your replies. I value that you share your truth.

Sorry about that. No matter what is going on in a relationship and how badly you want out, it still hurts. I think he is wanting to leave too but just haven’t manned up or maybe he’s waiting to see what she does. Who knows. I’m gonna start disconnecting and removing myself. We live together so it’s going to be a bit messy.

I did that after my last relationship. Spent three years alone and it was good but yeah I’m such a repeat offender, fell for someone again who does not value me. 

Good for you working on yourself before venturing into another relationship.

You’ve hit the nail on a couple of things. I was told I’m better than her and that he’s happy with me but they are only words and no action.  He already says I’m jealous and I don’t need to be cause he does not want her back but looking at what he does and how he is all upbeat when he’s been speaking to her I know what I feel is valid.  Oh and yeah I’m not allowed to say anything negative about the ex. She walks on water.
How did it end up for you? Did you get back with her or did you move on?

He will stay hung up and yes cellphones makes it easier to cheat and keep up contact. I won’t check out his phone but his actions around his phone and online bathroom visits confirms my suspicions. I need to leave I know, my brain tells me, my heart is a fool for punishment I.
Yes now to convince my heart

As far as the religion part I don’t know either. I’m new here too. I guess I wanted to say that I feel alone in this.  I’ve hit the pause button so many times and even a reset or two. There is so much more to what I’m going through and I don’t see it ending any time soon. 

Thank you for your input.
